what: Dominion Energy supplies electricity in Virginia and South Carolina and natural gas in several states. Virginia's data centre cluster, the largest in the world, sits inside its service territory.
customers: Households, businesses and data centre operators in Virginia, South Carolina and nearby states.
money: regulated electricity generation and delivery in Virginia
electricity and gas in South Carolina
the Coastal Virginia offshore wind project and other generation
moat: A regulated monopoly in a territory with the fastest electricity demand growth in the country, with rates set by state regulators.
risks: Debt of about $48 billion makes it sensitive to interest rates
The Coastal Virginia offshore wind project is very large and has had cost increases
Virginia regulators decide how data centre load is charged
It cut its dividend in 2020 and growth since has been modest
opportunities: Data centre demand in northern Virginia gives it the strongest load growth of any US utility
A simplified portfolio after selling the gas distribution businesses
Every approved investment raises the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Data centre connection requests and the cost and schedule of the offshore wind project.
